counts: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
list: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words (list frozen 2026-11-18). Guides are our own words, written from those descriptions.

sources.own: Our own advice, written from the official description. The game launched 19 Nov 2026, so steps no official description pins down are marked not yet checked in the game.
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — PSN progress targets and counts: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 are earned. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers, then the map sweep, then the grinds — and use Next Up to see what is left. Do the six flagged setup trophies when their moment comes so the end is not a replay marathon.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is usually the first trophy of the run. Follow the prompts; mission trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies come from the story alone — play the missions in order and it pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 2. Same rule as every chapter trophy: finish the story missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. Keep to the main missions; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Finish the missions in order and it unlocks when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is gold because it marks the end of the story, not because it is hidden away — play through Chapter 4 and the finale opens. Its mission name is a spoiler, so the guide keeps it hidden until you earn it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. Mission trophies cannot be missed, so just follow the markers when it opens.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions bring their own setup steps — take the prep the game offers, then run the heist; the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It arrives through the normal mission flow — reach its point in the story and finish it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finishing that mission is the whole requirement; play the story in order and it comes to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown around Vice City International Airport. Follow the mission markers and the trophy unlocks when the takedown is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A late-story mission trophy — it comes naturally if you keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion counter: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted grinds together. Check the in-game stats screen for the gaps and use this guide's checklist to close them; leave the long counts (250 stunts, 50 challenges) for the cleanup stage when the map is fully open.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, airtime, near misses and similar feats all feed one counter that carries across the whole game. Chain stunts in free roam: find a ramp, land the jump, keep moving. No time limit and no single spot is required, so let it build while you play and grind the rest at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest of Leonida's leisure. You only need to sample each one, not win anything, so work through activities as you meet them and this pops early.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each is a short timed shooting trial with a target score — and every one is repeatable, so a failed run costs nothing. Learn a challenge's layout first, use the weapon it hands you, and take the ranges one at a time. It is a long grind, so spread it across the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn the gates on a practice run, then race for the win — each location counts on its own, so every one needs a win. Losses just mean racing that location again.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Try a new race each time instead of repeating a favourite; wins across race types all count, and races retry freely.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity — take his challenge when it is offered and out-fish him. A loss just means challenging him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any game counts, so pick the shortest one you like and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Contact strands build mission by mission — keep taking Andy's missions as they appear and the finale unlocks. The final mission's name stays hidden here until you earn it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they come up and the strand ends with this trophy. Contact finales cannot be missed — the strand waits until you finish it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep accepting Billy's missions when they appear; the finale is the trophy, and there is no deadline on contact missions.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — the Strangers & Freaks-style side chains scattered across Leonida. Each strand is a small chain for one stranger; finishing one person's whole chain counts as one strand. Watch for stranger markers as you explore and do a strand when you find it. The five named contacts are five of the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's missions appear as you play; take them when offered and the strand ends with this trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's chain is one of the stranger strands, so it also counts toward the 8-strand silver — do it as part of the stranger sweep.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are quiet scenic places the game marks when you are near, and each one used counts. Work through them as you explore new areas; the count carries across the whole game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt is a stranger strand: take his missions until he names the animal, then track it down. The official description does not say which animal or where it roams, so this step is not yet checked in the game — follow Bret's own directions and the hunt will point at the target.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you find them, and a set completes when you hold every card in it. You need 3 finished sets, not every card in the game, so chase the sets you are closest to finishing. No card is missable.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each location counts once, so keep moving — revisiting the same spot adds nothing. The counter carries across the game, so let it build as you explore and mop up the last locations in cleanup.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's own challenge list — driving, combat, exploration and activities. Many overlap with other trophies (stunts, races, collectibles), so a good share will already be done by the end of the story. Check the in-game challenge list for the kinds you are short on, then target those.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road away from the city centre, raise the heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Retryable — a failed escape just means raising the heat again — but it needs your partner with you, so do not try it solo. Flagged only because the setup is specific.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level. Retryable, but the setup is specific — do it when the moment comes.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row — one after another, without losing your wanted level between them. Plan the route first: pick 3 shops close together, keep the getaway car ready, and move fast so the heat never drops. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over — that is why this one is flagged.
trophies.missableNote: The 3 robberies must chain without the wanted level clearing. Pick 3 shops close together first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride one and it counts as discovered. The total climbs fast if you try a new vehicle whenever you see one instead of sticking to the same car. Mop up the last few in free roam by driving through different districts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up: find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them before it ends. Four out of five fails the attempt — pick a busy fight rather than a quiet one, and retry until one clean run lands.
trophies.missableNote: All 5 takedowns must land inside one Combat Focus use. Find a fight with 5 or more enemies grouped together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule. The official description does not pin down the exact method, so this step is not yet checked in the game: the natural reading is to take an aircraft at the airport and fly out without a ticket or flight plan. Expect a wanted level; fly low and fast once you are up. Flagged because it is a single specific act.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off stunt at the airport. The exact method is not pinned down by the official description — flagged because it is a single specific act.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not a checklist, and it does not pin down what counts: the natural reading is to take on (or take over) a Rhino tank. This step is not yet checked in the game — look for military hardware in free roam or a mission and engage it; the trophy will tell you when it lands.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected from start to finish — no alarm, no witness raising it. Case the store first, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. Being spotted fails the attempt, so retry until one run is clean. A stealthy approach and a fast exit matter more than speed inside.
trophies.missableNote: One clean, undetected robbery. Being spotted fails the attempt — retry until it is clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, get clear before the response arrives. Each vault counts separately and the total carries across the game — do one when ready, escape cleanly, move on.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response catches you. A fast car and a planned escape route make it simple; if it goes wrong, another truck will come along.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida, from Vice City to the far corners of the state. Areas count when you enter them, so this is a long drive, not a puzzle: use the map to find unvisited areas and sweep through them in cleanup. It pairs well with the WAiNK and meditation counts, which are spread across the same map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The count is per gang, so keep a note of which gangs you have done — this guide's notes field is made for exactly that — and sweep the rest in cleanup.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bars, order a cocktail, enjoy the view — the trophy is for the moment, not a challenge. The description names no specific venue, so this step is not yet checked in the game; any beachfront bar with a view is the safe bet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive through a vehicle showroom's frontage and smash your way out — the classic GTA showroom exit. Pick a showroom, build speed, and go straight through the glass. It is a single stunt, retryable if the car gives up first, so bring a sturdy vehicle.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to the end. The alley is a named location in Vice City; head there, start a game, and finish it. The exact requirement beyond playing is not pinned down by the description, so this step is not yet checked in the game — a full game is the safe reading.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague and does not pin down what counts. The likely reading is a partner-activity moment the game tracks — play partner activities as they come up, and the trophy will land when the partnership hits the mark the game wants. Not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks this one toward a count of 500. Choices happen across the story, stranger missions and free-roam moments, so the total builds as you play; there is no single choice to find. If it is the last trophy left, replay choice-heavy missions and stranger strands.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The official list does not say what the something is, so this step is not yet checked in the game. The natural reading is a failed-then-passed attempt at a mission, challenge or activity — play normally, and when you fail anything, retry it at once; the retry is the trophy.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — an easter egg or a random odd event somewhere in Leonida. The description is a wink, not directions: it does not say where or what. This step is not yet checked in the game. Explore the map's odd corners, watch for unusual encounters, and the trophy pops when the strange thing happens to you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Set it up on a quiet road: get speed, line up a target on foot, and swing as you pass. If the hit misses, circle back and try again — retryable, but the hit has to land from the vehicle, which is why it is flagged.
trophies.missableNote: The takedown must be a melee hit from a moving vehicle. Line up a target on a quiet road and retry until it lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts wash them into clean cash, and the total counts toward $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on dirty money, and the total builds across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. The total counts every shop in the game, so just play and buy what you need; big purchases move it fast. If it is the last one left, buy and sell high-value items to push the total over the line.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought with clean cash, so save up — and launder Marked Bills first if you need clean money. Each garage also stores the vehicles you discover, so buy them as you explore new districts rather than all at once.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register them through the app — each new registration counts, and 10 is the target. Pair this with discovering 100 vehicles: every new vehicle you find is a candidate to register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
